_readme: Single source of truth for company facts. Every null is a deliberate placeholder — the build prints a report of them and the site renders 'уточнява се' instead of inventing a value. Fill these in before running paid traffic.
_buildMode: "draft" shows every unfilled block with the exact JSON key that fills it, so the site can be reviewed. "live" hides blocks that have no content yet, so a visitor never sees an empty promise or an internal field name. Switch to "live" before pointing traffic at the site.

ourRole.bg: Ние сме официален представител за България: консултираме избора на модел, изготвяме офертата за вашия парцел, организираме доставката, крана и монтажа и оставаме ваш контакт след предаването.
ourRole.en: We are the official representative for Bulgaria: we advise on the model, prepare the quote for your plot, arrange delivery, craning and installation, and stay your point of contact after handover.

forms._note: Until 'endpoint' is a real URL the form validates, keeps the data and tells the visitor honestly that it was NOT sent. It never fakes a success screen.

analytics._note: Nothing loads until an id is set here AND the visitor accepts the matching cookie category.
